title: Canonical code review record
description: Single source of truth for the chat summary, the Markdown report and the HTML report. Written by the reviewer, validated and rendered by scripts/render-review.mjs.

language.description: BCP-47-ish tag of the user's language, e.g. it, en. Drives report labels.

labels.description: Optional label overrides for languages the renderer does not ship.

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp; filled by the renderer when absent.

head_sha.description: Required for branch and commit scopes: a frozen verdict must name the state it was frozen on.

source.description: Where the spec came from: user prompt, issue #12, PR body. Never 'the implementation'.

text.description: The requested behaviour AS SUPPLIED: pasted verbatim, or the full extract of the acceptance criteria. Never your paraphrase — the criteria you enforce must be quotable from here.

verdict_reason.description: Evidence summary the verdict rests on.

verification.description: One entry per check the reviewer ran or could not run. Empty array forbids PASS.

status.description: Your judgment of the outcome, not the command's exit code.

target.description: change = the check judges the diff under review. baseline = the red predates the change; the same command already failed on the base.

result.description: Real output, verbatim or the decisive lines.

reason.description: Required when status is not_run: why it could not run.

test_audit.description: Skipped, disabled, trivial or non-representative tests, and uncovered spec requirements.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria taken verbatim from the spec. Required as soon as a finding cites one.

text.description: The criterion, verbatim. Never your paraphrase of it.

kind.description: acceptance = the spec asks for it. context = the spec explains, motivates or describes with it. A sentence can be verbatim and still not be a requirement.

from.description: The heading or section of the spec this was taken from, so the kind can be audited.

evidence.description: The verification command, finding id, or file:line that settles it.

standards.description: Rules written down in the repo's own docs. A convention that is widespread in the code but undocumented does not belong here.

source.description: file:line of the document that states it.

findings.description: In-scope findings only. Severity drives the verdict; see severity-and-verdict.md.

basis.description: Where the severity comes from: a spec criterion, a documented standard, or one of the three reasons that need no written rule. Mandatory for BLOCKER and HIGH.

evidence.description: The observed excerpt, command output, or missing-check statement.

how.description: Minimum fix. Mandatory for blocking findings.

required_fix.description: Defaults to true for BLOCKER/HIGH; must not be true for MEDIUM/LOW.

observations.description: Non-blocking, outside spec/scope. Cannot affect the verdict.

evidence_class.description: Required when you cite a location: say how you know.

for_human_review.description: Design decisions you do not have the context to settle. Never affects the verdict, never enters the fix menu.

decision.description: The choice to make. Not 'consider refactoring'.

compare_with.description: The sibling code the decision hinges on, when it does.

options.description: At least two defensible answers. One means it is a finding, not a decision.

strengths.description: Evidence-backed only. Omit rather than manufacture.

evidence_class.description: Required when you cite a location: say how you know.
